requirements.clause: When a user submits a complete, valid B2B registration form and clicks 'Create Account', the system must: (1) automatically create a new ERP Account using the Company Name, (2) create a Ship-To Address (Branch) using the physical address provided in the form, (3) create a new B2B customer account in an 'inactive' state, (4) immediately map the new inactive customer account to the newly created ERP account, and (5) redirect the user to a success page notifying them their application is under review.
The registration form's Company Info section requires: Company Name, Type of Business (dropdown), Email, Phone Number, Website URL, Address Line 1, Address Line 2, City, State, and Zip Code.

The registration form's Contact Details section requires: Contact Name, Position, and a Contact Media selection (WhatsApp or Messenger). Selecting 'WhatsApp' reveals a required WhatsApp Number field; selecting 'Messenger' reveals required Messenger Account Name and Messenger Account Link fields. Only the fields matching the selected Contact Media are required/shown.
The registration form's Account Setup section requires: Username, Password, Confirm Password, 'How did you hear about us?' (dropdown), and 'Tell us about your business'.

The registration form displays a Wholesale Account Agreement (informational text describing order minimums, pricing confidentiality, etc. — not itself a checkbox) and requires acceptance of exactly 3 checkboxes before the account can be submitted: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, and an 18+ Age confirmation. [Corrected during Stage 4 Live Exploration: live verification found only 3 real checkboxes, not 4 — the original requirement wording implied the Wholesale Account Agreement was a 4th checkbox.]

If a user submits the registration form with an Email address or Username that is already registered in the system, the system must block the submission and display a clear validation error message indicating the Email or Username is already in use.

The administrator must be able to view a submitted wholesale applicant's full application data via Admin → Advanced B2B/B2C → Registration Applications (/Admin/ErpRegistrationApplication/List), which displays the custom wholesale application data submitted by the user (Company Info, Contact Details incl. Type of Business, Contact Media, Position, Account Setup answers, and the 18+ Age confirmation), alongside ERP-side fields (Registration Number, VAT Number, Credit Limit Required) not present on the storefront form. [Corrected during Stage 4 Live Exploration: the requirement's original wording described a 'KD Registration Details' section on the customer's own profile page; live verification found no such section there — the Registration Applications grid is the confirmed real location, per owner confirmation.]

When an administrator, reviewing a pending inactive wholesale account already mapped to its ERP account, checks the 'Active' flag and saves, the customer account must become fully active (able to log in and use pre-mapped B2B features), and the system must automatically send a welcome/activation email to the customer.
